headline: Alignment Inertia measures when system prompts and LoRA fail to override prior behavior
summary: The Alignment Inertia preprint measures whether system prompts and LoRA fine-tuning override each model’s observed policy behavior on cases where that behavior conflicts with a target policy. It evaluates Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 on medical-misinformation and hate-speech datasets. Zero-shot prompting leaves some conflicting cases unresolved, with results varying by model, domain and policy direction; LoRA sometimes improves and sometimes worsens override success. These are author-reported behavioral results conditional on the study’s constructed divergence zones and adaptation data, not a universal measure of prompt or fine-tuning reliability.
